name: Crestview Realty
tagline: Homes with a view, sales with a record
description: A daylight limestone-and-slate brokerage site whose hero is a cursor-tilting isometric streetscape built from CSS planes, with tilting listing cards and a sold record priced to the dollar.

name: Hive
tagline: Four floors for people who make things
description: A honey-and-graphite coworking campus whose exploded isometric floor plan separates as you scroll, with tilting membership cards and a calendar of real community nights.

name: Velvet & Pine
description: A deep-pine and champagne wedding studio site with drifting floral parallax, an inked ribbon of light, tilting real-wedding portfolios, and an enquiry form that validates as gently as it reads.
